<function name="Sanitise" parent="table" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Converts <page>Vector</page>s, <page>Angle</page>s and <page>boolean</page>s to be able to be converted to and from key-values via <page>util.TableToKeyValues</page>.

<page>table.DeSanitise</page> performs the opposite transformation.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<file line="284-L338">lua/includes/extensions/table.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="tab" type="table">Table to sanitise</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table">Sanitised table</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Example of what this function does.</description>
	<code>
local table1 = { "A", "Golden", Angle( 1, 2, 3 ), Vector( 1, 2, 3 ) }

PrintTable( table.Sanitise( table1 ) )
	</code>
	<output>
```
1	=	A
2	=	Golden
3:
		__type	=	Angle
		p	=	1
		r	=	3
		y	=	2
4:
		__type	=	Vector
		x	=	1
		y	=	2
		z	=	3
```
	</output>

</example>
